Name: CREEM 2.0
Tagline: Build with AI. Sell and Grow with CREEM.
Description: - Creem 2.0 is the money platform for the AI building era: sell software and digital products globally, with payments, taxes, payouts, affiliates and usage billing handled for you - The all in one platform for AI builders to turn what they build into a business. Payments, taxes, billing, affiliates, payouts, worldwide. Building a product went from months to a weekend. Getting paid for it did not, with CREEM you can move at the same speed.

Name: Bitrise Remote Dev Environments
Tagline: Cloud Macs your coding agents can actually build on
Description: Bitrise RDE gives you cloud Macs & Linux machines that start in seconds, the same machines, stacks and caches as your CI. Give every agent its machine and run them in parallel via MCP, or attach VS Code, Cursor or Claude Code. Archive when you stop, restore later.

Name: Higgsfield API
Tagline: One async API for 50+ generative media models
Topics: Design Tools, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Higgsfield API is one authenticated, asynchronous API for generative media. Call Seedance, Kling, Soul, Grok Imagine, Wan, and 50+ frontier models through the same request lifecycle — submit, poll or webhook, download. Explore models in Console, get keys in Cloud, ship with Python/TypeScript SDKs. Pay per use with intro discounts up to 50% off your top models. Build your own Higgsfield at open.higgsfield.ai.

Name: NovaSynth by Noveum
Tagline: Test your voice agent on the callers you can’t stage.
Description: Simulate realistic callers at scale with custom personas, scenarios, interruptions, noise, accents, and network conditions. NovaSynth runs those calls against your voice agent, scores audio and transcripts across 30+ dimensions, and surfaces the failures and fixes that matter to your team.

Name: MCPJam
Tagline: The testing & evaluations platform for MCP servers
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Run User Testing, Swarms, Evals, and CI/CD gates on your MCP server to see if users actually succeed in ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot. Test local servers via desktop app, CLI, or SDK.

Name: Zella
Tagline: Video recorder that edits itself on Mac and iPhone
Description: Zella records your screen or camera and edits the video for you, on your own Mac or iPhone. Nothing uploads, no account, no subscription. Free at 1080p with no watermark. One tap runs Auto-Polish: captions, silence cuts, filler words removed, zoom-ins and a cleaned-up voice. Make it Viral adds pacing, transitions, sound effects and a music bed. Pro is one payment of $89 that unlocks Mac and iPhone together, for life, instead of a monthly bill.

Name: TinyKPI
Tagline: Your business analytics directly in your notch
Description: Connect the tools you already usefrom Stripe and PostHog to Google Analytics and your own database. Pick the KPIs you care about, arrange them your way, and keep them live in a tiny, customizable dashboard built around your MacBook notch. 100% local. Your data never leaves your Mac.

Name: Text Agent Store
Tagline: A marketplace for AI agents you can text
Description: Meet all the agents you can text. Agent Store is a directory of AI agents that live inside a contact in your phone book. Browse an ecosystem of texting agents, and send one text to start using them today. No account, no download, no setup.

Name: Axiom
Tagline: The modern machine data platform
Description: The modern machine data platform — Petabyte-scale, schema-less ingest on a fully managed event store, so you keep every byte without the operational cost of running it yourself.

Name: QAgent
Tagline: Automated QA for AI agents. Stop shipping on vibes.
Description: Automate AI agent quality testing. Score correctness, detect hallucinations against ground truth, verify policy adherence, and benchmark RAG before bad responses reach real customers.

Name: Modaal for Android
Tagline: Ship on both stores from one project using Swift + Kotlin
Description: Modaal for Android let you ship one app to both stores with your own AI agent - no rebuild. Rather than one React Native codebase that draws the same screens on both phones, Modaal shares the logic, not the screens: your agent writes real Swift/SwiftUI for iPhone and real Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for Android from one project, and the build proves both behave the same. So anyone who built an iPhone app with Modaal can add Android without touching a line of logic — no credit meters, no rebuild.

Name: Pitchfire for Startups
Tagline: Reach investors that are aligned with you
Description: Pitchfire for Startups is a new channel to reach investors. Upload your pitch deck, get matched to VCs with our AI, and let Pitchfire hype your startup with an email intro. Pitchfire brings investors and startups togethr. Over the past year, we've built AI associates for VC firms, and are now inverting the tech to match startups up with VCs. Sign up to get matched and intro'd to three investors a day. Upload your investor lists and we'll intro you if we have their contact data.

Name: Compute:Arena
Tagline: Community submitted benchmarks for Local AI
Topics: Open Source, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Apple
Description: Community-submitted performance benchmarks for local AI models on any hardware, any runtime, any quantisation.

Name: Analytiics
Tagline: Web and product analytics, set up by your coding agent
Description: Web and product analytics, set up by your coding agent. Your tracking plan lives in your repo and powers typed events, charts, funnels and CI checks. Understand visitors and revenue, measure anonymous traffic without cookies, and start free.

Name: Opyt
Tagline: Turn what you follow on X and Substack into a knowledge base
Description: Opyt turns the people and topics you already follow into a knowledge base. Point it at your X bookmarks, Substack subscriptions, blogs, GitHub repos or arXiv papers, and it pulls in their archives. It reads a topic through, writes its own follow-up questions, and keeps looking for new work that builds on what you've collected. Share what your knowledge base, keep exploring, and let your AI read it all. Free, MIT licensed, and your knowledge base can stay local.

Name: Die With Me
Tagline: AIM buddy list for your friends’ Claude Code and Codex usage
Topics: Social Media, Developer Tools, Menu Bar Apps
Description: An AIM buddy list for your AI usage. See friends’ Claude Code and Codex allowances as little mascots on your Mac. Set a status, visit their rooms, and unlock a chatroom when your allowance runs low. Your AI clocks out, but your friends are still here.

Name: Blanc
Tagline: A minimal browser with a floating island for a toolbar
Description: Blanc is a free desktop browser for macOS, Windows and Linux. Its floating Island replaces the tab strip and toolbar, while ad and tracker blocking runs at the network layer. Optional Patron adds Named Workspaces.

Name: MacSentinel
Tagline: Find what’s slowing your Mac then clean it safely
Description: MacSentinel brings Mac monitoring, diagnosis, storage analysis, and cleanup into one native workflow. Instead of simply showing system metrics or deleting generic caches, it explains likely causes of slowdowns locally, then helps you act safely. Smart Care includes 500+ app rules across 50 categories, covering developer, creative, productivity, and AI tools. Cleanup is Trash-first and recoverable, and Pro is a one-time purchase — no subscription.

Name: Amy by Jellyfish
Tagline: Your AI sourcing employee for recruiting teams
Description: Amy an AI sourcer for recruiting agencies. She learns what a company needs, searches across LinkedIn, GitHub, Google Scholar, and anywhere else on the web for people who may be a good fit, and explains why. She sends personalized messages, follows up, handles replies, and sends interested, qualified candidates to the recruiter.

Name: AskDeck
Tagline: Call an AI to get a PowerPoint and a narrated video back
Description: Every other AI deck tool makes you sit at a laptop and type a prompt. This one you can call. Brief Eric by phone, SMS, email or web — or from inside Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor via MCP. An editable PowerPoint (pptx) and a narrated video that presents it come back. Free watermarked preview: no account, no card. $29 once for the real file, yours to keep, no subscription required. Have a half-done deck? Upload it and Eric finishes it — polish, reskin to your brand, or build it out.
